items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin feeling clean without stripping or adding irritation.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the look of a comfortable, balanced skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 helps protect the look of uneven tone and marks from fading more slowly in the sun.

response.routine_note: We have left out the 30% peel and other strong exfoliants or retinol products because skin is often more sensitive in the months after isotretinoin, so please check with your dermatologist or prescriber before using any of them. Meanwhile, cleanse and moisturize morning and night and apply sunscreen every morning.
